ERR_ROUTER_NO_KEY.message: The command ends before it says what it is for

ERR_ROUTER_UNKNOWN_KEY.message: The board has nothing that answers {key}

ERR_ROUTER_BAD_LINK.message: {link} is not a connection the board knows

ERR_ROUTER_QUEUE_FULL.message: The board is busy: a command from {link} was dropped

ERR_ROUTER_FRAME_LEN.message: A frame of {len} bytes from {link} was refused (at most {max})
